import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    i = 0
    while i < len(data):
        n = int(data[i])
        i += 1
        if i + n > len(data):
            break
        arr = list(map(int, data[i:i+n]))
        i += n
        arr.sort()
        median = arr[n // 2]
        print(median)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
